question.worked_solution:
First, we cross-multiply:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{2x+5}{30} & =\frac{1}{2} \\ (2x+5)\cdot 2 & =30\cdot 1\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we proceed as usual to solve the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}(2x+5)\cdot 2 & =30\cdot 1 \\ 4x+10 & =30 \\ 4x+10-10 & =30-10 \\ 4x & =20 \\ \frac{4x}{4} & =\frac{20}{4} \\ x & =5\end{aligned}
$$
